round_3_proof.interaction_extra_in_pwml_trace: Root cause in code: pwml/ir.py (L4, lines ~2650-2700) draws a reaction's activator / inhibitor modifier as an interaction with the step's anchor element: the first other enzyme, else the first non-currency substrate, then product, else a currency compound (GTP, ATP). consistency.py explains only the enzyme anchor (modifier -> catalyst), so 'X -> GTP / ATP' (currency anchors) and 'FC1 -> Pchlide', 'ALAS2 -> heme' (substrate or product anchors) show as extras. Widening class g to modifier -> any participant of the reaction would explain them. Read from code, not re-run per example; kept as a named open item as ruled.

proofs.finding_compartment: 46 of the 59 failing runs fail only on compartment classes, and a diagnostic on three of them (runlist q-index 5, 8, 10; evidence/V7a/compartment_diagnostic.txt) shows they are not exporter disagreements about where things are, they are what each exporter chooses to draw. SBML lists an entity in every compartment the payload's states give it (chorismate in 'cell' and 'intracellular'); SBGN and PWML draw an entity only in the compartments where a process uses it (chorismate: 'cell' only); SBGN also assumes a compartment for a transporter or enzyme (TolC: SBML 'outer membrane', SBGN 'cytoplasm', PWML both). The check's grouping equality (SBML vs SBGN) and block-subset rule (PWML) do not allow that, so compartment_grouping_differs over-reports. Proposed redesign, not done (it changes check results, so the proof would be re-run): compare only entities with exactly one placement in both formats, count SBML-only placements as a known class (the SBGN exporter draws one glyph per (entity, compartment) used), and bound SBGN-only placements by the exporter report's notes compartment_assumed:*.

A strict per-format entity and compartment equality fails on every run with a transport or interaction. Probe classes, each traced to documented exporter behaviour and turned into a named 'known' class: PWML wraps a bare protein enzyme in '<protein> complex' (pipeline/entity_identity.py); the PathBank Unknown sentinel protein is not an entity in the clean model; PWML withholds interactions it cannot store (ir.processes.interactions[].withheld); a reaction's regulator is a modifier in SBML but an interaction with the enzyme complex in PWML; SBML puts an entity with no stated location in 'unspecified location'; PWML merges compartments under canonical names and places the ends of the interactions and transports it draws.
The compartment grouping rules (equality SBML vs SBGN, block subset for PWML) were a dead end in the same way: see proofs.finding_compartment.
